name: Lumpsum Investment Calculator
description: Calculate future maturity value, total compound wealth gained, real purchasing power, and wealth multiple for a one-time lump-sum investment.
search_intent: Calculate future returns on a one-time lump sum mutual fund, index fund, or equity investment.
calculation: Nominal maturity value: A = P × (1 + r / n)^(n × t), where P is initial investment, r is annual return rate as a decimal (return% / 100), n is compounding periods per year, and t is years. Total compound interest earned = A − P. Real inflation-adjusted value: A_real = A / (1 + inflation / 100)^t. Wealth growth multiple = A / P. Zero or negative returns are supported deterministically without dividing by zero.
limitations: Market returns fluctuate over time and past performance is not a guarantee of future returns.
Taxes (capital gains tax), expense ratios, and management fees are not automatically deducted.
